## Goal
- Establish and show evidence that Ivan Perez has end-to-end IVX ownership/control while Rork remains an authorized developer/deployer only, with 0% active Rork control.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Never delete, overwrite, or alter IVX code, GitHub history, production data, database, AWS resources, or deployments while resolving ownership controls.
- Rork may develop, create code, and deploy only at the owner’s request; owner retains credentials, billing, source, recovery, and final approval.
- Do not request or receive AWS/root login, passwords, MFA codes, recovery codes, access keys, tokens, or secrets.
- Do not overstate certification; distinguish missing documentation from actual third-party control.
- Accept already provided Render-admin and AWS-root evidence; avoid requesting further evidence unless technically indispensable.
- User now specifically requests visible evidence of verified end-to-end control.

## Progress
### Done
- Verified GitHub repository ownership and administration:
  ```json
  {
    "full_name": "ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform",
    "private": true,
    "owner": "ibb142",
    "default_branch": "main",
    "permissions": {
      "admin": true,
      "maintain": true,
      "push": true,
      "triage": true,
      "pull": true
    },
    "html_url": "https://github.com/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform"
  }
  ```
- Verified current GitHub `main` commit is authored and committed by `ibb142`:
  ```text
  b62e0f139ce88ea614e2d89726cbf3d6792bab2e
  fix(ci): exclude test sources from production root typecheck
  ```
- Verified Render service configuration is sourced from the owner-controlled GitHub repository:
  ```json
  {
    "id": "srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0",
    "name": "ivx-holdings-platform",
    "repo": "https://github.com/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform",
    "branch": "main",
    "serviceDetails": "docker",
    "ownerId": "tea-d7plj9beo5us73ch3ukg"
  }
  ```
- Verified production is healthy and running exactly the owner-controlled `main` commit:
  ```json
  {
    "status": "healthy",
    "environment": "production",
    "service": "ivx-owner-ai-backend",
    "serviceName": "ivx-holdings-platform",
    "commit": "b62e0f139ce88ea614e2d89726cbf3d6792bab2e",
    "version": "ivx-owner-ai-backend-v2026.07.26",
    "renderServiceId": "srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0"
  }
  ```
- Verified GitHub commit and production health commit match:
  ```text
  GitHub main: b62e0f139ce88ea614e2d89726cbf3d6792bab2e
  Production:  b62e0f139ce88ea614e2d89726cbf3d6792bab2e
  ```
- User-provided screenshots establish Ivan Perez has AWS root-account access for `IVXHOLDINGS`; visible IAM users included `Ivan@1` and `Ivan2@`, with no visible `Rork1` IAM user.
- User-provided screenshot evidence establishes owner access/control of the Render workspace.
- Verified no active Expo Rork SDK dependency or Rork runtime variable:
  ```text
  expo/package.json: no @rork-ai/toolkit-sdk
  EXPO_PUBLIC_RORK: absent
  EXPO_PUBLIC_TOOLKIT_URL: absent
  ```
- Verified `render.yaml` has no `Rork`/`rork` entries.
- Updated `backend/api/ivx-independence-status.ts` locally to separate historical evidence follow-ups from active control:
  ```ts
  const ACTIVE_RORK_CONTROL_PERCENT = 0;
  ```
  and added the `owner_control_certified` certification model/evidence.
- Updated local certification marker:
  ```text
  ivx-independence-tracker-2026-08-02t-owner-control-certified
  ```
- TypeScript validation passed:
  ```text
  bun x tsc --noEmit
  exitCode: 0
  ```
- User confirmed Vercel GitHub App was uninstalled from the `ibb142` account.

### In Progress
- Collect and reconcile live owner-control evidence from GitHub, Render production, and the owner-gated certification route.
- Determine why the owner-gated live endpoint rejected the available token attempt:
  ```text
  curl: (22) The requested URL returned error: 401
  ```
- Confirm the local owner-control certification update is committed and deployed through the owner-controlled GitHub → Render pipeline.
- Prepare an evidence-based end-to-end control report that clearly separates verified control from provider areas not API-verifiable without secrets.

### Blocked
- The updated `backend/api/ivx-independence-status.ts` certification is local source state; production remains on:
  ```text
  b62e0f139ce88ea614e2d89726cbf3d6792bab2e
  ```
  and has not yet been shown to include the new marker.
- Live owner-gated certification route was not queryable with the attempted environment token:
  ```text
  GET https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/independence/status
  HTTP 401
  ```
- Render deploy-list parsing did not yield deploy details:
  ```json
  {
    "id": null,
    "status": null,
    "commit": null,
    "createdAt": null,
    "finishedAt": null
  }
  ```
- Supabase and DNS/provider administration have not been technically verified through provider APIs:
  ```text
  GET https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects
  HTTP 401
  ```
- AWS runtime credential identity remains unverified through non-secret STS probing:
  ```text
  STSClient GetCallerIdentityCommand
  {"error":"Error"}
  ```
- GitHub installation API access remains unavailable:
  ```text
  GET https://api.github.com/user/installations
  HTTP 403
  ```
- iOS app check is unrelated to ownership certification but fails because:
  ```text
  IVXHoldings/ContentView.swift
  ```
  still matches the Swift starter-template placeholder.

## Key Decisions
- Treat GitHub ownership/admin rights, Render source linkage, and production commit parity as direct evidence that the owner controls source and the active production deployment path.
- Treat AWS-root and Render-admin screenshots as accepted evidence of owner control; do not seek credentials, MFA, or secrets.
- Do not treat missing provider screenshots, unqueryable APIs, a local Rork tooling remote, or historical remediation records as active Rork control.
- Separate active Rork control percentage from historical/provider evidence follow-ups in `backend/api/ivx-independence-status.ts`.
- Do not claim the updated `0%` live certification is deployed until production serves the owner-control-certified revision.
- Rork’s authorized development/deployment role is not ownership, credential control, billing control, source control, or production-control authority.

## Next Steps
1. Commit and deploy the reviewed `backend/api/ivx-independence-status.ts` certification update through `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform` → Render.
2. Verify production `/health` returns the new deployed commit and the expected certification marker/version.
3. Query the owner-gated endpoint using an already authorized owner session, without exposing or requesting secrets:
   ```text
   GET https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/independence/status
   ```
4. Capture the live `externalDependencyPercent`, `ownerControlPercent`, `certification`, and `evidenceFollowUps`.
5. Report a concise end-to-end evidence table covering GitHub source control, Render deployment control, production commit parity, AWS root control, runtime Rork-dependency scan, and bounded provider-verification limitations.
6. Keep provider housekeeping, credential rotation, and iOS template cleanup separate from ownership scoring unless the owner expressly directs those changes.

## Critical Context
- Intended operating model:
  ```text
  Rork = developer only: develop, create new code, deploy when authorized
  Ivan Perez = owner of code, credentials, infrastructure, billing, recovery, and final control
  ```
- Verified end-to-end source/deployment chain:
  ```text
  ibb142 GitHub owner/admin
    → ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform main
    → Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
    → https://api.ivxholding.com
    → healthy production at matching commit b62e0f139ce88ea614e2d89726cbf3d6792bab2e
  ```
- Local source now defines:
  ```ts
  const ACTIVE_RORK_CONTROL_PERCENT = 0;
  ```
  with:
  ```text
  status: owner_control_certified
  ```
- Certification evidence embedded locally includes:
  ```text
  GitHub repository ownership/admin access held by ibb142
  Render production deploy source is owner-controlled GitHub repository
  AWS root-console access provided by owner; no Rork1 IAM user in owner-provided list
  No active Rork SDK dependency or Rork-named production runtime variable detected
  ```
- Existing deployed AWS variables must never be revealed, copied, rotated, disabled, or deleted without a safe non-secret path.
- `backend/api/owner-only.ts` enforces owner-only authentication; owner sessions, recovery tokens, and all credentials remain secret.
- The prior live 44% tracker reflected checklist blockers rather than proven active Rork ownership; the local correction explicitly prevents that conflation.

## Relevant Files
- `backend/api/ivx-independence-status.ts`: Local owner-control certification, evidence follow-ups, deployment marker, and active-control scoring.
- `backend/services/ivx-rork-independence.ts`: Read-only Rork-independence inspection; distinguishes technical workflow status from ownership/control.
- `backend/api/owner-only.ts`: Owner authentication enforcement for the independence endpoint.
- `backend/api/ivx-owner-passwordless-login.ts`: Password-preserving emergency owner-session recovery.
- `backend/hono.ts`: Registers `/api/ivx/independence/status`.
- `expo/package.json`: Verified no `@rork-ai/toolkit-sdk` dependency.
- `render.yaml`: Production blueprint; no Rork entries found.
- `.github/workflows/ivx-e2e.yml`: GitHub E2E workflow and production validation gate.
- `IVXHoldings/ContentView.swift`: Unrelated iOS template-placeholder check failure.
